title: Home Timer
missing: This area or station does not exist (anymore).
empty: No area is set up yet. Add one to give it timers, stations and presets.
area.add_hint: Home Assistant's areas without Home Timer:
area.none_free: Every area already has Home Timer. Create more areas in Settings › Areas.

area.delete_confirm: Remove Home Timer from {area}? Its stations, presets, timers and entities are deleted.
options.title: {area} – options
options.hint: For all timers of this area.
options.ring_until_acknowledged_hint: Otherwise a timer ends when it runs out.
options.reminder_minutes_hint: While ringing, a reminder event every … (0 = none)
options.auto_dismiss_minutes_hint: A ringing timer is acknowledged by itself after … (0 = it rings until acknowledged)
options.report_missed_hint: Timers that ran out while Home Assistant was down still fire their events after the start.
quick_timers.long_hint: Presets without a station: each gets a start button on the area's device.
station.name: Name
station.delete_confirm: Delete {station}? Its presets, its timer and its entities go with it.
mode.manual_hint: Presets and buttons; you start the timers.
mode.power_hint: A power sensor tells when the appliance runs; the timer follows it.
presets.hint: Each preset gets a start button. Drag or use the arrows to sort them – the buttons follow.
preset.name: Name
power.thresholds_hint: It runs above this power and has stopped once it stayed at or below it for this long (short dips are ignored; runs under 10 s do not count).
kind.start_preset_hint: e.g. rice 20 min when switched on
power.cancel_on_off_hint: Switching it off before the end cancels the timer.
rule.off_hint: Done when the appliance has stopped – kettle, toaster.
rule.pause_hint: Done when the power stays below a level for a while – appliances that pause when done.
rule.cycling_hint: Done when the share of time at a level within a window falls – thermostat appliances.
rule.drop_hint: Done when the power falls by a share within a time – e.g. a moka pot.
rule.knee_hint: Done when the power falls a factor faster than before – the same, independent of the level.
rule.time_hint: Done after a fixed time – only for very regular runs.
rule.energy_hint: Done after a fixed energy – only for very regular runs.
now.hint: To start or stop timers, use the dashboard or the station's buttons.
discard_confirm: Your changes on this page are not saved yet.
notice.fix_errors: Not saved – please check the marked fields.
notice.changed: Changed elsewhere meanwhile (e.g. “Save as preset” on a dashboard). The current state is loaded – please make your change again.

settings.sidebar_hint: Off: open it with the cog of an area or “Open” on a device.
